declarations.type:
∀ (key : SearchLoopCacheIdentity.SemanticKey) (newSelector : SearchLoopCacheIdentity.Digest),
  key.selector ≠ newSelector →
    SearchLoopCacheIdentity.decideSemanticReuse key (SearchLoopCacheRelocation.relocateSelector key newSelector) =
      SearchLoopCacheIdentity.CacheDecision.invalidate
declarations.name: SearchLoopCacheRelocation.selector_drift_invalidates_without_relocation

declarations.type:
∀ (cached current : SearchLoopCacheIdentity.SemanticKey),
  SearchLoopCacheRelocation.relocateSelector cached current.selector = current →
    SearchLoopCacheIdentity.decideSemanticReuse (SearchLoopCacheRelocation.relocateSelector cached current.selector)
        current =
      SearchLoopCacheIdentity.CacheDecision.reuse
declarations.name: SearchLoopCacheRelocation.explicit_relocation_rekeys_to_reuse
